text: If N=64 seeds 20-21 are trained to 12000 steps with matched data and best-of-3 controls, does their force margin also keep creeping up (about +0.02-0.03 over steps 6000-12000)? If so, the N=64 vs N=128 gap (about 0.03-0.06) persists at every training length, which points to a lower ceiling at N=128 rather than slower growth.
